confidence_notes: Mombasa-specific cost-of-living figures are available, though meal, coffee, and beer values vary across datasets and venues. Cocktail is based on local bar-guide prices; wine per glass is estimated from its local price relationship to beer because a reliable typical glass price was sparse. Accommodation prices are holistic estimates and were not checked against live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Mombasa-specific cost-of-living prices and local bar guidance; no comparable city was needed.
